title: Cloud agent PR descriptions must keep task references when updated
answers: Why did the agent drop the Actions run link from the PR description?
PR description lost issue and PR references after update
How should agents write PR descriptions so review context is kept?
Keep failed job URLs and upstream links in the PR body
body:
Invariant: a PR description written by the Copilot cloud agent must state why the change is needed, not only what it does.
It must keep the task's references: issues, PRs, GitHub Actions run/job URLs (including failed jobs and agent-run URLs), documentation, upstream changes, and supporting measurements or logs.
When the description is rewritten or updated, existing references stay unless they are no longer relevant. Dropping them removes the review context that reviewers rely on.
Enforced only by the instruction text in `.github/instructions/cloud-agent.instructions.md` (section `## Pull request descriptions`); there is no code check.
Constraints: this is guidance for the agent; human-authored descriptions are not covered by it.
applies: Any change where the Copilot cloud agent creates or edits a pull request description in this repository.
says: The automated agent removed linked issues and run URLs from the pull request summary.
Why did the cloud agent clear previous workflow links when updating the pull request?
Pull request descriptions generated by the agent should explain the rationale behind the change.
Keep links to failing workflow runs and upstream changes in automated pull request summaries.
The coding agent overwrote review context and logs during the pull request description update.
